## Publications 

\*, <sup>†</sup> Indicates equal contribution  



```{r, echo=F, warning=F, message=F}
publications <- cv_entries %>% 
  filter(grepl("publication", type)) %>% 
  mutate(when = NA) %>% print_section() %>% 
  gsub(pattern = 'Caitlin F. Harrigan', replacement = '<u>Caitlin F. Harrigan</u>')
```

`r publications`
